history.headline: Panels filters
changes: Sorting and reading filters share a popup, with Comic locations beside the library title.

history.headline: PDF comics in Panels
changes: Read PDF comics with the same page controls, zoom and saved reading progress.
Sort comics by title, date added or modified date, with numbered titles and folders in reading order.

history.headline: Reliable uploads and lighter builds
changes: More natural wording throughout Settings, Help, uploads and file management.
Uploads reconnect when you return to Luma, with one button to retry any failures.
Flick scrolls with your finger in both directions, and fullscreen controls fade reliably.
Folder dates follow renames, moves and uploads, with lighter folder refreshes.
Docker builds now compile one app at a time to ease memory pressure on small servers.
Pull down in a folder to check for new or changed files without scanning its subfolders.
Select folders with a tap, with cut, copy, rename and delete in each item’s menu.
Restore all or empty the recycle bin, with clearer confirmation and reliable list updates.
Removed folders disappear after refresh, and completed uploads and recycle actions clean up their empty staging folders.
Paste visible files while discovery runs, with queued progress and protection against repeated clicks.

history.headline: Ready for translations
changes: Shorter messages and a clearer Help guide.
Release notes now focus on the major changes.
English is still the only available language.

history.headline: Uploads and destination conflicts
changes: Run independent uploads and file operations together.
Choose Replace or Skip when uploads, moves or copies meet an existing destination.

history.headline: Delete from Flick
changes: Delete files from Flick and continue watching the next reel.

history.headline: Rename files and keep viewing
changes: Rename files and folders from file management or the viewer menu.
Keep viewing after deletion and manage files in search results.

history.headline: Viewer deletion and saved position
changes: Delete from the Gallery viewer and return to your last viewed photo.

history.headline: Cut, copy, paste and upload
changes: Manage files with cut, copy, paste, new folders and a recycle bin.
Upload files or folders with drag and drop; transfers continue after closing the dialog.

history.headline: Continue reading and smarter shelves
changes: Resume recent comics from Continue reading, with saved page progress and smart folder covers.
Improved comic reading, pinch zoom and mobile search.

history.headline: Compact mobile search
changes: Expand and collapse search on phones across Gallery, Collections, Flick and Panels.

history.headline: Organized comic shelves
changes: Browse comic subfolders, tag comics and keep comic locations out of Gallery.
Compact reader controls include page jump and reading progress.

history.headline: Simpler setup
changes: Enable file management directly in Settings without administrator tokens.
Browse mounted folders when adding comic locations.

history.headline: Gallery, Flick and Panels
changes: Switch between Gallery, Flick and the new Panels comic reader from the Luma logo.
Uploads, file management, a recycle bin and optional SRT captions.
New appearance options, grouped Settings and a Help guide.

history.headline: Refresh and default Reels order
changes: Choose a default Reels order and refresh Gallery without starting a scan.

history.headline: Faster Reels and restored sessions
changes: Faster Reels browsing and automatic restoration of your last view and filters.

history.headline: Smooth browsing during scans
changes: Browse large libraries smoothly while indexing runs in the background.

history.headline: Faster folders and resilient scans
changes: Faster folder covers and reliable scan recovery after a server restart.

history.headline: Folder refresh and app themes
changes: Prioritize the folder you are browsing during a scan.
Installed apps follow your chosen theme colors.

history.headline: Updates, release notes and Nord
changes: Update notifications, What’s New and the Nord theme.
More accessible background jobs, filters and playback controls.
